run_doxygen_fruit: run doxygen on the fruit.dox documentation file to generate XML output
run_doxygen_xml2qbk_grouped: run doxygen_xml2qbk to convert the group__fruit XML into a grouped Qbk file
run_doxygen_xml2qbk_apple: run doxygen_xml2qbk to convert the classfruit_1_1apple XML into an apple Qbk file
run_doxygen_xml2qbk_structs: run doxygen_xml2qbk to convert fruit_value and fruit_type struct XML into Qbk files
run_bjam_build: run bjam to build the project after generating Qbk documentation files
